title: Boss: The Crashing Counter
story: A number-adding script crashes on blank lines and on missing files, and leaves the file open. Find all the bugs.
goal: Fix read_numbers(path): sum the whole numbers in the file, ignore blank lines, and return 0 if the file does not exist.
hints: Which line crashes on an empty line? What does int("\n") do?
A missing file raises FileNotFoundError. Also prefer with open(...) so the file closes itself.
socratic: What does int of a blank line do?
What does open do when the file is missing?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what was the bug, and how did you fix it?
